QUOTE: The product handlers import `ServerDataOperatorBase` as a type only. They are plugged in through the same `mix(...).with(...)` call, so they can use `this.batchRecords` and `this.processRecords` from the base.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says every handler write funnels through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords()`. It also says handlers get `this.batchRecords` via the `ServerDataOperatorBase` typing. It also lists handlers that bypass `batchRecords`, so the "every handler" claim is not quite universal, but the substance of the item is stated.
